CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition (A) was found to bind with any identified content (C).

COD.rationale: C, O and D are individually explicit for the same referent (p0/current/n0) and time, but the attributes cited in the explicit evidence (origin / represented_time / red) differ in kind; the attribute-level binding is therefore ambiguous for the strict COD definition.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is related to an identified content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies node p0/current/n0 and gives an origin attribute with metadata (kind, record_time, represented_time).

D.rationale: The report separates the node's content (red coordinate listing) from origin/status metadata, thereby distinguishing identified content from status/organization information.

O.rationale: The origin metadata includes a represented_time field that describes how/when the node is represented (presentation/access property) for the identified node.
